title: HandLive — call_event/log_sync (C→S, ack with data)
description: CALL-04 API 1. The client repeats the request with the cursor of the page it just stored while has_more = true; a first sync (no cursor, or reset) covers at most 500 entries of the last 90 days (CALLLOG_SYNC_WINDOW). Success ack: one page, #/$defs/ack; error ack: #/$defs/ack-failure.

cursor.description: The cursor received with the previous page or the previous sync; absent on the first sync.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries in the page: the client sends 200; Android accepts 1–500.

cursor.description: Opaque to the client; Android writes b64u of the JSON {"v":1,"id":<largest _ID covered>}.

ack-data.description: One page, entries in ascending entry_id order; Android closes a page at 180 KiB of plaintext, so the envelope stays below 256 KiB.

cursor.description: The cursor after this page; the client stores it in the same transaction as the page.

reset.description: true when Android ignored the cursor it received and returns the first page of a first sync (CALL-04 E5); the client then deletes the pair's call log in the same transaction.

ack-failure.description: Error ack of call_event/log_sync: FEATURE_DISABLED, PERMISSION_MISSING (READ_CALL_LOG), BAD_REQUEST (limit outside 1–500), INTERNAL.
